acquisition_profile_note: CONFIG.profile refers to this table, not transport speed. Channel physical-to-ADC conversion/calibration is not implied by a profile name. Different profile/model domains remain separate.

boot_mode.configuration_change: stop, new session, new complete canonical BOOT hash and matching BOOT_ACK before ENABLE; mode alone is insufficient

action_rules.STOP: same valid session/CRC; yaw_q=pitch_q=speed_code=ttl_ms=0; observed_seq ignored; no fresh observation required; never enables motion
action_rules.SET_TARGET: only after all ENABLE gates; same-session recent observed_seq; positive bounded TTL; validate quantized combined curvature before applying; duplicate does not renew TTL

fault_rules: ACK3D uses 8 bits; STATE3D uses the identical low 8 and zero high 8. No fault means zero. Any fault prevents a new nonzero motion grant. Unknown/reserved nonzero flags are rejected, not ignored. Clearing faults and enabling remain separate stopped-state operations.
capture_quality_rules: HIL requires low mask15 plus independent physical validation for current BOOT profile. Encoded quality bits alone do not establish hardware evidence. PC_DIRECT never fabricates these bits as board motion capture.
